question: 同固定历史股票队列，年度盈利/经营现金创造能力能否在动量之外改善月度选择收益、风险或可观察维护/分散用途
scope: 独立财务扩展，不进入原LEI技术判定，不代ETF/全市场/账户可执行收益
reviewer: gpt-6-astra/high candidate_method_review final design accepted by root

reuse.old_price_momentum_results: reuse saved core-v1/per_stock_month.csv; never rerun old core
reuse.not_independent_confirmation: previously viewed historical price outcomes; two new financial hypotheses not unknown history

candidates.registration: local versioned definition in this attachment, not represented as existing central registry entry
candidates.formula: (consolidated operating revenue - consolidated operating cost) / same year end total assets
candidates.mechanism_hypothesis: assets with greater gross earning capacity may provide information beyond price trend

candidates.registration: local versioned definition in this attachment, not represented as existing central registry entry
candidates.formula: consolidated net cash flows from operating activities / same year end total assets
candidates.role: sole predefined supplemental cash generation candidate
candidates.mechanism_hypothesis: cash generation may differ from accrual gross earning capacity
candidates.not_measured: high CFO does not by itself establish honest or cash-supported gross profit

record_qualification.retained_signs: negative and zero amounts retained, assets strictly positive
record_qualification.publication: original publisher date converted Asia/Shanghai; strictly publication_date < decision_date, no invented publication clock
record_qualification.annual_version: newest report year available, latest qualified full version within that year; later older-year release never replaces newer annual; original canceled labels do not cause future deletion
record_qualification.latest_failed: latest expected full annual parse failed => unknown, no falling back older to avoid failure
record_qualification.max_age: report period end plus 16 calendar months inclusive; revision never resets age
record_qualification.same_report: consolidated current year income/cashflow and end year assets; exact period/currency/scale and evidence pages required; no parent company, total operating revenue or comparative restated backfill
record_qualification.corrections: semantic body review and affected years/fields; uncertain financial correction invalidates affected currently-used fields after its public date until qualified complete version, not unrelated newer years; partial numbers cannot mix version without explicit unchanged evidence
record_qualification.audit_opinion: describe only where actually qualified; no new audit screen
record_qualification.unqualified: explicit missing reason, never zero filled

industry.source: 12 saved year end BaoStock historical proxy snapshots; arrival/public availability not independently verified
industry.snapshot_rule: latest snapshot query_date <= decision_date, each updateDate < decision_date
industry.code: CSRC leading letter + two digits e.g C26
industry.unknown: not in main sector comparison; no future snapshot fill
industry.within_year_limit: year-end series does not establish all intra-year transitions

pools.cash_common: GP + CFO qualified; recompute GP methods on this identical pool for direct financial candidate comparison
pools.never_future_filter: future return missing keeps original target weight and recorded outcome status

selection.industry_weights: n industry / n common pool each month, same for all methods
selection.rank: ascending percentile, equal values average rank; final top cutoff tie by code
selection.tiny_sectors: n<5 all methods hold full sector, label no effective selection

methods.B: within industry 0.5 momentum percentile +0.5 financial percentile, top20%
methods.D: 0.5 M target weights +0.5 P target weights; overlaps add

selection.forbidden: no third GP+CFO blend, no grids, no choosing direction/window/sector weights by returns

returns: future unknown -100% and0 scenarios not true recovery bounds
unknown target weight and halt nonactionability reported
risk: same P-down month methods and paired differences
marked quote cumulative path/drawdown only if no missing months, not executable account

uncertainty.positive_statement: 97.5% considers selection between two candidates; report both lengths and all candidate results, no multiple-risk-stat winner claim

stability.time_claim: <120 comparable months cannot claim completed ten-year effect test; 120 alone does not prove coverage sufficient

adapter: native factor workflow currently lacks this cross-sectional financial/original filing adapter; dedicated frozen hashes + synthetic qualification + controller independent reconciliation, no false native pass
